svg.title: Example system
svg.desc: Nodes: Shopper (person); Shop web app (client, TypeScript); Shop gateway (gateway); Payments API (service, degraded); Orders API (service, Go); Orders database (database); Order events (queue, RabbitMQ); Payment provider (system, External); Fraud check (service). Edges: Shopper calls Shop web app. Shop web app calls Shop gateway over GraphQL at 30/s: Places orders. Shop gateway calls Orders API over grpc: Creates orders. Orders API calls Orders database over PostgreSQL. Orders API sends messages to Order events: Announces orders. Order events (order-placed) sends messages to Payments API. Payments API calls Payment provider: Charges cards. Payments API calls Fraud check across regions.
